review.rationale: Option A correctly resolves the validation self-reference problem by freezing the candidate ref at the Decision commit and writing all validation results, reports, and execution evidence to a distinct evidence branch. This mirrors standard CI practice where the tested artifact remains immutable and the test report is externally SHA-bound. The contract explicitly enforces zero commits after freeze, distinct evidence ref, SHA binding to candidate/canonical/merge-tree, replacement PR creation only after PASS, and separate decisions for PR #22 closure and merge. All rejected options correctly identify their respective flaws: B causes infinite recursion, C leaves the final PR head unvalidated, D fails to cover governance-only paths, and E downgrades validation to post-hoc recording. The recommendation preserves immutable candidate boundaries, prevents remote mutation, and maintains proper separation of concerns across PR closure, merge admission, and evidence archival.
